# **AIConfigurator 0.4.0**

AIConfigurator is a tool that helps users find optimal configurations for deploying LLM inference workloads in distributed, multi-GPU environments.AIConfigurator 0.4.0 adds extensive support for the SGLang backend, covering DeepSeek WideEP path and regular path with dense and MoE models support. We also added dense models support for vLLM backend. With this release, AIConfigurator now supports all 3 major backends: TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, and vLLM.

## **Release Highlights**

AIConfigurator 0.4.0 significantly expands backend support, achieving coverage for all three major backends. This release introduces support for L40S GPUs, Qwen3 30B A3B MOE models, and direct HuggingFace model loading via `--hf_id`.

Additionally, it adds prefix cache modeling support to simulate workloads with system prompts or prefix cache hits, and unifies SGLang paths for better maintainability.

## **Features and Improvements**

### **1\. New Hardware Support**

* Added L40S support for TRT-LLM (by [@ilyasher](https://github.com/ilyasher) in [\#91](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/91))

### **2\. Framework Support**

* Added SGLang attention collector (by [@Atream](https://github.com/Atream) in [\#73](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/73))  
* Enhanced allreduce data collector to enable data collection for vLLM backend (by [@Arsene12358](https://github.com/Arsene12358) in [\#87](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/87))  
* Added SGLang disagg support (by [@jasonqinzhou](https://github.com/jasonqinzhou) in [\#84](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/84))  
* Added SGLang agg support (by [@jasonqinzhou](https://github.com/jasonqinzhou) in [\#93](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/93))  
* Added vLLM disagg support (by [@ilyasher](https://github.com/ilyasher) in [\#89](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/89))  
* Added vLLM agg support (by [@ilyasher](https://github.com/ilyasher) in [\#98](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/98))  
* Unified SGLang WideEP and regular paths (by [@tianhaox](https://github.com/tianhaox) in [\#99](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/99))

### **3\. Expanded Model Support**

* Supported using `--hf_id` as an alternative to `--model` (by [@simone-chen](https://github.com/simone-chen) in [\#86](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/86))  
* Added Qwen3 30B A3B MOE model support (by [@jasonqinzhou](https://github.com/jasonqinzhou) in [\#58](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/58))

### **4\. Modeling and Improvements**

* Added prefix length modeling support (by [@tianhaox](https://github.com/tianhaox) in [\#77](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/77))  
* Added version subcommand (by [@jasonqinzhou](https://github.com/jasonqinzhou) in [\#72](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/72))

### **5\. Build, CI and Test**

* Added linting and formatting with Ruff, created a developer guide (by [@anish-shanbhag](https://github.com/anish-shanbhag) in [\#65](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/65))  
* Added A100 to e2e test (by [@simone-chen](https://github.com/simone-chen) in [\#64](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/64))

## **Bug Fixes**

* Added supported systems to CLI help (by [@jasonqinzhou](https://github.com/jasonqinzhou) in [\#63](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/63))  
* Fixed MLP context state (by [@AichenF](https://github.com/AichenF) in [\#78](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/78))  
* Moved Gradio to optional dependencies (by [@Arsene12358](https://github.com/Arsene12358) in [\#90](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/90))  
* Fixed LLAMA2\_7B and LLAMA2\_13B errors (by [@ilyasher](https://github.com/ilyasher) in [\#97](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/97))  
* Fixed webapp compatibility with SGLang and vLLM (by [@tianhaox](https://github.com/tianhaox) in [\#100](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/100))  
* Fixed collector minor problems (by [@tianhaox](https://github.com/tianhaox) in [\#101](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/101))  
* Enhanced log file collection with Path and error handling (by [@xutizhou](https://github.com/xutizhou) in [\#92](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/92))

## **Documentation**

* Updated README to include A100 SXM in support matrix (by [@simone-chen](https://github.com/simone-chen) in [\#62](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/62))  
* Added git lfs pull step before install from source code to download full data files (by [@cr7258](https://github.com/cr7258) in [\#69](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/69))  
* Added more A100 docs (by [@jasonqinzhou](https://github.com/jasonqinzhou) in [\#67](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/67))

## **New Contributors**

* @cr7258 made their first contribution in [\#69](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/69)  
* [@anish-shanbhag](https://github.com/anish-shanbhag) made their first contribution in [\#65](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/65)  
* [@xutizhou](https://github.com/xutizhou) made their first contribution in [\#92](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/92)

# AIConfigurator 0.3.0

AIConfigurator is a tool that helps users find optimal configurations for deploying LLM inference workloads in distributed, multi-GPU environments such as those using NVIDIA H100, H200, GB200, B200, A100, or future hardware with the Dynamo backend.

Currently AIConfigurator supports NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM as the primary inference engine, with limited support for SGLang.

## Release Highlights

AIConfigurator 0.3.0 introduces significant expansion in hardware support, framework compatibility, and model coverage. This release adds support for multiple new GPU architectures, introduces SGLang framework integration, and expands the model library with new Qwen3 variants and GPT-OSS models.

## Features and Improvements

### 1. New Hardware Support

- Added GB200 GPU support (by @YijiaZhao in [#32](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/32))
- Added B200 GPU support with TensorRT-LLM 1.0.0rc6 data (by @tianhaox in [#36](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/36))
- Added A100 GPU support (by @simone-chen in [#55](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/55))

### 2. New Framework Support: SGLang and Wide-EP

**Note: SGLang support is currently limited and experimental.**

- Added SGLang GEMM collector and performance data (by @Atream in [#28](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/28))
- Added SGLang MLA-BMM collector and performance data (by @Atream in [#29](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/29))
- Added SGLang MLA collector and performance data (by @Atream in [#31](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/31))
- Added SGLang fused MoE Triton collector (by @Atream in [#39](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/39))
- Added support for disaggregated DeepSeek in SGLang (by @AichenF in [#54](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/54))

### 3. Expanded Model Support

- Added several Qwen3 models (by @tianhaox in [#30](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/30))
- Added GPT-OSS support in AIConfigurator SDK (by @Arsene12358 in [#56](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/56))

### 4. Configuration Generation and Evaluation

- Refactored generator as a standalone module for improved modularity (by @Ethan-ES in [#40](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/40))
- Added new CLI and SDK support for presets in search space configuration (by @tianhaox in [#44](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/44))
- Added AIPerf integration for performance evaluation (by @Ethan-ES in [#57](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/57))
- Improved aggregated and disaggregated modeling and performance (by @tianhaox in [#45](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/45))

### 5. Collector Improvements

- Enhanced collector to support data collection for windowed attention and additional MoE configurations (by @Arsene12358 in [#33](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/33))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed LICENSE file (by @saturley-hall in [#21](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/21))
- Added allowed path workspace configuration (by @tianhaox in [#23](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/23))
- Updated MoE tuning logic (by @YijiaZhao in [#19](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/19))
- Updated Gradio version for compatibility (by @saturley-hall in [#35](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/35))
- Improved error handling for database loading failures (by @tianhaox in [#37](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/37), [#38](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/38))
- Enhanced Kubernetes support with corresponding documentation (by @Ethan-ES in [#50](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/50))
- Changed NVIDIA SMI command from -lgc to -ac (by @LyleLuo in [#49](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/49))
- Excluded FP8 from MLA generation post-processing test cases for Ampere architecture (by @simone-chen in [#52](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/52))
- Fixed TensorRT-LLM 1.0.0 collector compatibility (by @tianhaox in [#48](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/48))
- Improved tensor initialization to occur directly on device (by @ilyasher in [#51](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/51))
- Enabled SDK tests in CI pipeline (by @ilyasher in [#46](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/46))

## Documentation

- Added guidance for adding new models (by @tianhaox in [#26](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/26))
- Added NVIDIA SMI clock locking script to README (by @jasonqinzhou in [#47](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/47))
- Added git LFS pull step to installation instructions for downloading full data files (by @saturley-hall in [#71](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/71))
- Enhanced A100 documentation (by @saturley-hall in [#70](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/70))

## New Contributors

- @Arsene12358 made their first contribution in [#33](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/33)
- @ilyasher made their first contribution in [#41](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/41)
- @biswapanda made their first contribution in [#42](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/42)
- @LyleLuo made their first contribution in [#49](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/49)
- @AichenF made their first contribution in [#54](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/54)

For the complete list of changes, see the [full changelog](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0).

# AIConfigurator 0.2.0 

AIConfigurator is a tool that helps users find optimal configurations for deploying LLM inference workloads in distributed, multi-GPU environments such as those using NVIDIA H100, H200, or future hardware with the Dynamo backend.

Currently AIConfigurator supports NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM as inference engine. 

## Release Highlights

AIConfigurator 0.2.0 brings several new features, improvements, and important fixes to enhance configuration workflows and automation. 

## Features and Improvements

### 1. Automation

- Added automation evaluation support (by @tianhaox in #5)

### 2. Collector improvement

- Mix-of-Expert collector now supports autotuning for improved efficiency (by @YijiaZhao in #11)

### 3. Dynamo upgrade 

- Upgraded to Dynamo 0.5.0 (by @Ethan-ES in #13)

## Bug Fixes

- Switched to using torch flow collector and added more default memory configuration options (by @tianhaox in #7)
- Improved performance alignment logic and reliability (by @tianhaox in #10)
- Enhanced mixture-of-experts (MoE) support: added power law handling and improved solver calculation for generative attention (by @tianhaox in #15)
- Added safe directory creation to mitigate security risk and clarified error handling (by @tianhaox in #16)

## Documentation

- Improved README (https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/blob/main/README.md) for clarity and precision (by @nealvaidya in #9)

## New Contributors

- @nealvaidya made the first contribution in [#9](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/9)
- @Ethan-ES made the first contribution in [#13](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/pull/13)

For the complete list of changes, see the [full changelog](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0).

**AIConfigurator** is a tool designed for Dynamo to optimize disaggregated serving for generative AI models. It automatically finds optimal deployment configurations by searching thousands of candidates in tens of seconds, helping you achieve better throughput and latency in disaggregated serving.

### Major Features
* Automated Configuration Search: Search across thousands of deployment configurations to find optimal one of both disaggregated and aggregated system and do intelligent choice of disaggregated or aggregated deployment.
* SLA-based Optimization: Optimize under TTFT (Time-To-First-Token) and TPOT (Time-Per-Output-Token) constraints to address throughput@latency problem
* Dynamo Integration: Seamless integration with Dynamo by automatic generation of deployment configurations
* Multi-framework Support: Compatible with NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM backend with extensible architecture for other frameworks (coming soon)

### Model and System Support
* Comprehensive Model Support:
  * GPT
  * LLAMA (2,3)
  * MoE
  * QWEN
  * DEEPSEEK_V3
  * NEMOTRON model families
* System Support: H200 SXM and H100 SXM

### User Interfaces
* Command Line Interface (Suggested): Simple CLI with 3 basic arguments for quick start and configuration generation
* Web Application: Interactive web interface for advanced configuration tuning and visualization
